entities.name: UAS Services
entities.description: Services supporting Unmanned Aircraft Systems including UAV identification, authentication, authorization and C2 communication authorization.

entities.name: CAA-level UAVID
entities.description: An identifier assigned to the UE supporting UAS services before accessing 5GS for UAS services.

entities.name: Aerial Subscription
entities.description: A valid subscription in the UE's subscription that enables registration to 5GS for UAS services.

entities.name: UE supporting UAS services
entities.description: UE capability to support Unmanned Aircraft System services.

relations.description: UAS services require the UE to have an assigned CAA-level UAVID before accessing 5GS.
Registration for UAS services requires a valid aerial subscription in the UE's subscription.
UE supporting UAS services enables access to UAS services procedures.
